spec: DACS-1 v0.8 §6.3.4 RSC-1..RSC-9 authoritative revocation completeness
decisionModel: only authenticated current-head non-membership passes; verified inclusion fails as revoked; every incomplete/conflicting proof is indeterminate
inputModel: authenticated Listing projection plus exact signed heads/markers, sparse proofs, finalized receipts, key-authority results, and binding-authenticated current-state context

testBinding.note: This deterministic signed-current-value adapter does not claim a deployed Demos capability.

vectors.name: rsc-valid-active-nonmembership
vectors.note: an exact empty-leaf proof against the authenticated current head admits a new session

vectors.name: rsc-valid-revocation-inclusion
vectors.note: an exact inclusion proof and marker refuse the revoked listing

vectors.name: rsc-censored-tombstone
vectors.note: an active discovery row cannot hide a revocation committed by the current head

vectors.name: rsc-stale-signed-head
vectors.note: a valid old signed head is not the current finalized native value

vectors.name: rsc-two-equivocated-heads
vectors.note: two valid children of one head at one sequence block selection

vectors.name: rsc-invalid-nonmembership
vectors.note: a sibling mutation cannot establish the signed root

vectors.name: rsc-latest-proof-unavailable
vectors.note: a finalized head without authenticated latest-state evidence is incomplete

vectors.name: rsc-cross-tuple-proof-replay
vectors.note: another listing tuple's proof cannot establish this listing

vectors.name: rsc-revocation-marker-unresolved
vectors.note: a committed leaf without an independently resolvable marker fails closed

vectors.name: rsc-rollback-below-listing-checkpoint
vectors.note: the current view cannot move behind the checkpoint signed into the listing

vectors.name: rsc-unauthorized-rotation-key
vectors.note: a cryptographically valid head from an unauthorized key has no seller authority

vectors.name: rsc-authorized-rotation-key
vectors.note: an authenticated rotated seller key may append an exact revocation

vectors.name: rsc-historical-listing-without-state-ref
vectors.note: an old listing remains audit-readable but cannot enter the current new-session profile

vectors.name: rsc-checkpoint-history-gap
vectors.note: a later head cannot substitute for the complete checkpoint chain

vectors.name: rsc-producer-time-cannot-prove-latest
vectors.note: producer time cannot replace an authenticated current-state policy

vectors.name: rsc-rb4-discovered-marker-precedes-nonmembership
vectors.note: a verified discovered marker cannot be ignored even when the state proof says absent

vectors.name: rsc-rb5-indeterminate-precedes-nonmembership
vectors.note: an unresolved discovered revocation record prevents state non-membership from returning absent
